Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

Why would Katie’s mother, a plain and simple Amish-woman who embraces the old ways, hide a beautiful satin baby dress in the attic? The staggering answers come on the eve of Katie’s wedding to widower, Bishop John Beiler, with the arrival of a beautiful “Englisher” woman who has been searching for her, throwing Katie’s life – present and future – into confusion.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane intensity of the DUPR Collegiate National Championship as the "one-seed" Utah Tech takes on the powerhouse University of Virginia in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This episode captures the breakneck "racing" pace of rapid-fire volleys at the kitchen line and the elite "skills" displayed through high-quality dinking and precision resets. Witness "freestyle" creativity from top-tier athletes like Alexandra McDonald and "soccer goalie" Dylan Ciampini, who deliver spectacular inside-out forehands and highlight-reel winners. With a spot in the finals against the reigning champions on the line, these collegiate rivals battle through a grueling MLP-style format where every point counts.

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: All her life Katie Lapp has longed for the forbidden things, but will her dreams come at a price too dear to pay? Why would Katie’s mother, a plain and simple Amish-woman who embraces the old ways, hide a beautiful satin baby dress in the attic? The staggering answers come on the eve of Katie’s wedding to widower, Bishop John Beiler, with the arrival of a beautiful “Englisher” woman who has been searching for her, throwing Katie’s life – present and future – into confusion.
